summary.en: The Detective Boys are on their way home (presumably after school), and, when they pass through the bottom of a building, they discover two S-Hooks and a wedding ring engraved with the initials M to A. They believe that this combination of items is an S.O.S. message, and therefore decide to investigate the building and its residents. Location: Apartment building Suspects: People resident of the rooms that end with 5 A woman sends an SOS message for someone to rescue her.
